name: hermes-knowledge
description: Comprehensive Hermes Agent (Nous Research) knowledge base with 21 reference files covering CLI commands, configuration, toolsets, gateway platforms, skills system, memory, scheduling, subagents, security, VPS operations, troubleshooting, and cost optimization.
author: hermes-forge build

hermes-expert.description: General Hermes Agent expert. Answers any question about Hermes Agent using the comprehensive reference knowledge base.

hermes-mission-planner.description: Generates complete Hermes Agent mission briefs from raw tasks with skills, commands, toolsets, config, scheduling, delegation, delivery, safety, model recommendations, and paste-ready prompts.

hermes-troubleshooter.description: Diagnoses Hermes Agent errors using comprehensive troubleshooting reference covering 25+ verified errors, doctor command, log analysis, database repair, gateway issues, config migration, and recovery procedures.

hermes-cost-optimizer.description: Provides cost optimization strategies covering model routing, auxiliary models, budget monitoring, free tier usage, provider comparison, and cost-effective scheduling patterns.

hermes-security-auditor.description: Performs security hardening audits covering approval modes, sandboxing, allowlists, secret handling, supply chain, network egress, gateway security, and VPS hardening.
